subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a new public cron run status and plugin-visible lifecycle classifier for yielded parent runs, or should this remain internal while preserving existing public status contracts?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent, but changing cron status values, SDK exports, and channel progress semantics is a compatibility and product contract decision that source review and tests cannot safely make for maintainers.

options.title: Accept `deferred` as public
options.body: Merge after Discord-visible and upgrade-compatibility proof show existing cron/API/CLI/UI consumers handle the new status safely.

options.title: Keep status internal
options.body: Revise the implementation so public cron/Gateway/CLI/UI surfaces preserve existing status values while internal runtime tracks yielded waiting state separately.

options.title: Split narrower fixes
options.body: Land a smaller internal subagent wake/reconciliation repair first and defer public status/API changes to a sponsored design PR.

recommendation.title: Accept `deferred` as public
recommendation.body: Merge after Discord-visible and upgrade-compatibility proof show existing cron/API/CLI/UI consumers handle the new status safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The related main-session yield-pause work makes this person the strongest visible routing candidate for yielded-session lifecycle contract review.
